script.speaker: brooke
script.text: lunch crew, round two! i added mina, she's in my drawing elective

script.speaker: mina
script.text: hi maya :) thanks for letting me join. how's everyone's week going?

script.speaker: maya
script.text: hi mina!! my week: long. my stomach: empty. i'm running on fumes

script.speaker: maya
script.text: i need pizza. i've been smelling it from the dining hall all morning and i can't take it anymore

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: just not the greasy, heavy kind for me. something fresh and light

script.speaker: maya
script.text: fresh is fine. CHEAP is mandatory. one dollar sign max, it's all for the trip fund

script.speaker: mina
script.text: a trip? that sounds lovely. where are you going?

script.speaker: maya
script.text: the coast!! still saving. i have eaten so much toast

script.speaker: mina
script.text: pizza sounds good to me too. and don't worry about me, i can always just pick the pepperoni off

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: wait, mina, you're vegetarian! you told me in class. picking it off doesn't count

script.speaker: maya
script.text: absolutely not. we are going somewhere with real veggie pizza. i will riot otherwise

script.speaker: mina
script.text: oh, i didn't mean to make it complicated. i can just get a salad or something

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: no way! we want you to eat pizza too. it's lunch crew, not lunch solo

script.speaker: maya
script.text: exactly. and if we have to, we'll all get veggie pizza. no one is going hungry today

script.speaker: mina
script.text: ...okay, a proper veggie pizza would actually make my day. thank you both

script.speaker: maya
script.text: that's what lunch crew is for!

script.speaker: maya
script.text: assistant pls hurry, i'm about to eat this chat
